description: Order dispatch-eligible issues by: (1) priority ascending, where 1..4 are preferred and null/unknown sorts last; (2) created_at oldest first; (3) identifier lexicographic tie-breaker. The vector asserts the resulting identifier order.
given: { issues: Array<{ identifier: string, priority: integer | null, created_at: string }> }

vectors.description: Priority 1 before 2; within priority 1 the older created_at wins; null priority sorts last regardless of age.
Equal priority and created_at fall back to lexicographic identifier order.
An unknown/null priority sorts after an explicit priority 4 even when far older.
